## Release checklist

Complete this section only for a `release/vX.Y.Z` pull request.

- [ ] The package version is `X.Y.Z`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` contains `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD`

- [ ] Upgrade, backup, and migration notes are complete
